name: OS3
long_description:
We are building robots, including custom actuators. Our first model is trained for the robot with 150k hours of video data. 

The robot, a mobile semi-humanoid priced, is already signed for deployments in hospitality and biotech. Our developer version lets anyone deploy robots in their own verticals, and we already have preorders.

We are scaling American robotics while making it accessible to more businesses.
one_liner: Full Stack Robotics: Deploying US-Built Robots & Video Action Models
